tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Check a URL or domain for phishing and scam risk before visiting, clicking, or transacting with it. Returns a verdict (safe | warn | danger), a 0-100 risk score, a plain-English summary, and specific findings (brand impersonation, typosquatting, community scam reports, threat-feed hits). Costs 1 sca

tools.name: scan_message
tools.description: Analyze a message, email, or text for scam indicators before acting on it (payment requests, verification codes, urgency pressure, impersonation). Returns a verdict (safe | warn | danger), a 0-100 risk score, a summary, and specific findings. Costs 1 scan credit.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Check the API key’s remaining prepaid scan credits, monthly plan usage, and credit expiry. Free — consumes no credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_url · Private data: get_usage · Public sink: scan_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_url · Private data: get_usage · Public sink: scan_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
